title: Security Risk Governance Analyst
description:
About the role

We’re hiring a Security Risk Governance Analyst to help strengthen how Chime identifies, assesses, and manages security risk across our third-party ecosystem and internal control environment. You’ll work across vendor security reviews, risk assessments, controls testing, and key compliance initiatives, while helping turn security requirements into clear, repeatable processes. You’ll partner closely with teams across Security, Risk, Compliance, Engineering, Application Security, and Infrastructure Security to identify gaps, manage risk, and move assessments through to completion. You'll work alongside Senior Analysts who hold risk coverage for Chime's business domains, taking secondary coverage for one of them as you build depth. This role is a strong fit for someone building a security risk career who is organized, curious, and follows an assessment through to a documented decision.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $105,000.00 and up to $145,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

• Run third-party security reviews end to end: due diligence assessments, evidence collection, vendor interviews, and ongoing monitoring.

• Support SOX IT General Controls, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 programs with audit preparation, evidence collection, and walkthrough coordination.

• Conduct risk assessments, gap analyses, and controls testing, including reviews of new tools, AI systems, and new lines of business arriving through Security intake. Record findings, remediation owners, and risk exceptions in the SRG risk register and track them to closure.

• Run quarterly user access reviews for applications in scope for SOX, SOC 2, PCI, and ISO 27001, including population builds in ConductorOne, reviewer follow-up, revocation and lookback handling, and evidence retention.

• Help define and maintain security KPIs, KRIs, and dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into risk and program performance.

• Develop or source security training content and support delivery to employees and contractors through a learning management system.

• Create and maintain operational runbooks, security baselines, and standards, and work with SRG engineering to move manual evidence collection into automated workflows.

• Move Security Architecture Reviews through the process with Security Engineering, Application Security, and Infrastructure Security, and help document the steps as they stabilize.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 2-4 years of experience in security, IT audit, risk, or compliance, or equivalent experience in a regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience with at least one of: third-party security reviews, risk assessments, or controls testing.

• Professional experience focused on information security, security risk, and/or security program management.

• Experience using vulnerability management tooling and managing security risk exceptions through their lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC 2, NIST 800-series or NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS.

• Experience documenting security procedures, operational processes, standards, and runbooks.

• Evidence of driving work to closure through people you don't manage: chasing owners, unblocking, and escalating when it stalls.

• Comfort working without a fully defined path, and a habit of raising problems early with a proposed next step.

• Progress toward a security or audit certification such as CISA, CRISC, or Security+ is a plus. We support analysts in earning them.

• Experience working with AWS, GitHub, and/or GCP is a plus.

title: Facilities Supervisor
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

The Facilities Supervisor is responsible for leading facilities operations across a multi-building campus that includes manufacturing, warehouse, and office environments. This role ensures maximum facility uptime so that people, processes, and equipment operate without interruption. The Facilities Supervisor will provide exceptional leadership to Facilities Technicians while maintaining a hands-on presence in daily maintenance and repair activities.

 

This position requires a strong bias toward action, speed to execution, a rigorous preventive maintenance program, and uncompromising standards for quality and safety.

 

GENERAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership & Supervision

• Supervise, coach, and develop a team of Facilities Technicians.

• Establish clear priorities and drive rapid execution of maintenance tasks and repairs.

• Maintain high performance expectations with strong accountability for quality and safety.

• Schedule and allocate resources to ensure timely completion of work orders and preventive maintenance.

• Foster a culture of urgency, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Facilities Operations & Maintenance

• Oversee maintenance and repair of manufacturing, warehouse, and office facilities.

• Ensure facility systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed air, dock equipment, lighting, etc.) remain fully operational.

• Respond quickly to unplanned downtime or facility-related disruptions.

• Personally perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs as needed.

• Coordinate with external vendors and contractors when required.

Preventive Maintenance & Reliability

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust preventive maintenance program.

• Ensure scheduled PMs are completed on time and documented accurately.

• Identify root causes of recurring issues and implement long-term corrective actions.

• Drive initiatives that improve building reliability, efficiency, and longevity.

Safety & Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to safety standards and regulatory requirements.

• Conduct regular safety inspections and correct hazards immediately.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 We’re Legl .
Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services.
We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting.
Legal work is high-stake - it’s regulated, complex, and deeply impactful - and our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences
We’re backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK’s top 200, launched in the UK and Australia - and entering our next phase of growth.
We Work Best When

• AI is the central-operating model: not a tool or a future plan - but the way we run.

• Decisions live with people: you're trusted to make calls and own them.

• Think deeply, execute quickly: speed and rigour, not speed or rigour.

What You’ll Do
As the Technical Solutions Engineer at Legl , you’ll play a crucial hands-on role at the intersection of product, engineering and customer delivery. Legl has a growing catalogue of PMS and DMS integrations (Clio, Actionstep, NetDocuments, iManage and others, with more launching this year through our partner ecosystem), plus a quickly growing need for more customer and partner enablement on our APIs and technical capabilities. Your job is to make sure this wide variety of integrations land inside every customer launch and across the existing base.

• Own the technical workstream inside customer launches. Scope the integration at kick-off, coordinate the customer’s IT and third parties, configure and deploy, and verify it actually works before and after go-live.

• Activate and monitor the installed base. We are always looking for ways to add value for our 600+ clients using industry-leading integrated capability. You will help existing customers implement integrations and monitor usage to ensure their teams are getting as much as they can out of them.

• Be the technical counterpart to implementation partners. Set the technical plan partners deliver against, review their configuration before go-live, and serve as the quality gate on partner-delivered work.

• Productise deployments. You will work closely with the integration engineering team to make each launch slicker, quicker and less manual every time we do it. The product will grow with you

• Support commercial teams. Join prospect and customer calls as the technical voice, run discovery with customer developers and help commercial teams scope and implement integration requirements.

This Role Is a Great Fit If You…

• Are as happy building relationships with a developer team and getting into the nitty-gritty of how to handle a data sync as you are presenting to stakeholders about its value.

• Obsess with understanding customer goals, timelines and problems.

• Are comfortable owning the customer-facing side of our technical deployments, and collaborating heavily with our team from Sales to Customer to Support to EPD to our Partners.

• Understand when to engage, when to productise, and when to push back on requirements.

• Love the heady complexity of technical delivery and commercial customer problems at the edge of legaltech operations.

This Role Is Not a Great Fit If You…

• Would rather develop in isolation instead of getting stuck in with customer teams

• Are lost when it comes to APIs and integration patterns

• Dislike ambiguity - every day is a school day!

• Think if you build it they will come. We need proactivity with customers

• Can’t adapt to new tooling, platforms and ways of working - we work across a broad tech stack with our customers, and ship every day!

title: Trader - Trading Origination
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.
Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?
What’s the position?
The Trading Origination team is a recently formed group responsible for pricing provided by our in-house models. As a Trader within Trading Origination, you will primarily be responsible for ensuring we produce accurate prices, maximise uptime and respond quickly to any issues that arise.
Success in this role means more than execution - it requires identifying opportunities, understanding the evolution of game strategy, and acting upon emerging patterns to optimize our trading models. By combining a commercial mindset with collaboration and innovation, you will help shape a best-in-class sportsbook that anticipates customer needs and adapts to the ever-changing dynamics of sport.
Key Responsibilities:

• Help with day-to-day trading operations, ensuring markets are competitive, accurate, and aligned with commercial goals

• Ensure the models and data feeds are working as expected, and if not, work with the necessary teams to ensure service is restored in a timely manner

• React as required to any item that requires a change to a game state (e.g. injury news)

• Collaborate with others to enhance pricing models and improve the trading tools that we use

• Undertake data-related projects as required in order to gain insight on changes to betting trends

• Ensure regulatory requirements and responsible gambling standards are met across all trading activity

• Participate in in-person sessions with the team as required for collaboration, training, and planning purposes

• Take an active role in competitor analysis to ensure our product is constantly improving

Requirements
What are we looking for?

• A strong passion for and outstanding knowledge of US team sports

• A good understanding of probability and betting odds, ideally with industry experience in a Trading department

• A solid ability to focus on accuracy, competitiveness, and long-term profitability

• Analytical and data-fluent, with the ability to understand, validate, and explain pricing model outputs

• Highly motivated and dependable

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Comfortable with working weekends and evenings to meet the requirements of the business and the sporting calendar

• Willingness to travel for in-person sessions with the team

What’s in it for you?
We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

• Competitive pay and benefits

• Flexible vacation allowance

• Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

• A vibrant, collaborative environment designed to foster a high-energy, high-performance trading culture

• The opportunity to continually contribute to making Hard Rock Bet a top-tier sportsbook

Roster of Uniques
We care deeply about every interaction our players have with us. We trust and empower our teams to own and shape the customer experience. Our vision is grounded in fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone-regardless of background or beliefs-can bring their authentic selves and full range of talent. We celebrate you being you.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Trust and Safety)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering team 

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the role

The Trust and Safety Foundations team within Checkout Engineering builds and operates foundational systems and data capabilities that support how Affirm understands consumer risk and meets its credit reporting obligations. Our work sits at the intersection of data quality, system reliability, regulatory requirements, and risk, creating critical infrastructure that Affirm and its partners depend on to operate accurately and at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Trust and Safety Foundations, you will help shape the team’s technical strategy and lead complex, business-critical initiatives across systems and stakeholders. You’ll turn ambiguous problems into clear technical approaches, guide projects from strategy through execution, and strengthen the reliability and sustainability of the systems we own. You’ll also act as a force multiplier by raising the bar for system design and engineering quality, sharing your expertise, and helping other engineers grow. This role requires strong technical judgment, deep ownership, and the ability to navigate complexity in a high-impact domain.

.

What you’ll do

• You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

• You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.

• You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

• You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

• You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

• You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

• You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

• You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.

• You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

• You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.

• Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

• This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

title: Director/Senior Director, Molecular Discovery
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.

This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.

What You'll Be Building

• Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.

• Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.

• Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.

• Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.

• Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote in London, UK.

 

You will carry a book of 40-60 mid-market and emerging accounts - companies in the <$1B range, closing 25-40 deals a year at $40k-$100k and building toward larger standard deal sizes as our packaging moves upmarket. You work in a pod with a dedicated Mid-Market Engagement Manager on a shared book, with a comp plan designed to maximize earnings and customer value.

 

We are architecting the best GTM team in all of AI. If you want to grow, run fast, and sell with a leading-edge frontier AI company with room to grow your career, please apply.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run a high-velocity full-cycle motion: 25-40 closed deals a year across inbound and outbound

- Qualify hard and fast - your book is big, your calendar is the scarce resource, orientation to clear ROI and value orientation is a must

- Push deal size up: committed-volume, use-case expansion plays that turn $30k starts into $100k+ repeatable motions

- Turn product signals (usage spikes, team signups, credit burn) into pipeline

- Work with your pod's Engagement Manager so new customers hit consumption targets and your held-back commission unlocks

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 3+ years of full-cycle closing experience in SaaS/AI with a quota record above 100%

- Velocity evidence: 20+ closed deals a year, multi-channel prospecting, disciplined qualification

- Native AI-tool fluency - you already sell with AI in your workflow, not despite it

- Writing and demo skills strong enough to carry a deal without a solutions engineer

- Coachability with a track record: name the coaching that changed your numbers

 

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

- Sold to creative or marketing teams

- PLG or usage-signal selling experience

- BDR-to-AE promotion in your history - we like people who earned the chair

 

COMPENSATION

OTE $270K - $300K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity.

title: Sales Development Representative (copy)

We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full.

This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams.

What You'll Do

Generate and Qualify Pipeline

• Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles.

• Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit.

• Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.

• Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points.

• Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions.

• Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting.

• Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing.

Partner with the Sales Team

• Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline.

• Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward.

• Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved.

• Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM.

Bring the Market Back In

• Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.

• Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies.

• Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating.

• Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations.

• 1-4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role.

• A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations.

• Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling.

• Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before.

• Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging.

• Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way.

• The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets.

• The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams.

• A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly.

Nice to Have

title: Expert Tech Solution Architect - HR (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As Senior / Expert HR Tech Solution Architect , you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix’s global HR technology landscape.

Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization - ensuring our technology enables Flix’s future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.

You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team - including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts - builds within.

This role is based in Munich, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.  

About the Role

• Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems - ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.

• Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations - evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization.

• Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems - determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures.

• Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations.

• Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live.

About You

• 8+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field.

• Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the role

We're hiring a Chief of Staff to keep Cohere's AI organization running at full speed. You'll report to and support the Chief AI Officer and work to bridge across all teams and functions at Cohere (including research, modelling, product, delivery, security, sales and operations). In any given quarter, the org ships new AI product demos and releases, customer pilots and scaled solutions, security updates, often across regions and time zones. Your job is to make sure the right work priorities win when everything feels urgent, that our plans turn into high-quality shipped work, and that our Chief AI Officer can focus on leading instead of firefighting.

Much of this is operational: the planning calendar, the budget, the headcount plan, the weekly business reviews, the communication strategy (internal and external), the cross-functional handoffs. Your role is the operating rhythm of the org: meetings, priorities, plans, and the decisions that come out of them. You will be a member of an experienced, high-performing and supportive leadership team.

What you'll own

Own the operating rhythm and planning: annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Drive budget and headcount planning against the slate, and keep both honest as priorities shift mid-quarter.

Keep major programs from colliding or stalling across research, modelling, product, delivery, and security. Be the person teams come to when it isn't clear who owns a decision, or how to navigate trade-offs.

Be the connective tissue between the Chief AI Officer’s org and the rest of the company: cross-functional planning with product, engineering, security, and finance, so the org's commitments are realistic and its dependencies are visible.

Own and lead special projects: Lead the things that don't fit neatly on any one team's plate: a reorg, a new partnership, a flagship research event, an org-wide planning week. Own them end to end.

Who you are

You have 12+ years of operating experience, with real time inside an AI/ML organization in a Chief of Staff, business operations, or senior program-operations seat. You know how to partner with teams shipping fast & often to high-stakes organizations, and you know how to change course with agility when needed.

You understand how AI actually works-at the level of someone who's done it rather than managed it from a distance. You can talk credibly about how a model turns into a product, what data requirements demand from both research and engineering, and where delivery motions usually break. You're fluent in the numbers. Model performance metrics, data pipeline throughput, budget-to-impact. You don't have to run every program yourself. You do have to understand them well enough that the people who run them respect your judgment.

You hold strategy and execution in the same hand. You can sit in a planning conversation with the Chief AI Officer in the morning and chase down a stuck deliverable in the afternoon.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, you handle ambiguity with curiosity and confidence, you stay calm when it's messy. You

title: Recruiter - Sales
description:
TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST SNAPSHOT

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Talent Sourcing

- Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

- Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

- Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

- Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

- Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

- Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

- Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

- Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

- Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

- Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

- Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

- Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

- Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

- Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

- Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

- Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

- Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

- Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

- Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

- Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

- Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.

Hiring & Onboarding Partners

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine -only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

About the Role
The Director of Strategy & Operations, Partnerships is the day-to-day thought partner to the Chief Business Officer and his leadership team, and owns how the partnerships organization plans and executes.
The scope centers on Partnerships (Business Development and Partner Success), plus the supply and enterprise sales cycles that touch the partner motion.
Your mandate is to uplevel how it runs. You will influence strategic direction and help drive execution, while finding and unblocking the productivity bottlenecks that slow the team down. AI is central. You will decide where AI belongs in the partnerships motion and hold the team accountable to real productivity gains.
This is a hands-on role. You will get into the data yourself and build the analysis leadership acts on. You will hire and lead a team of two to four analysts and operations partners over the next 12 to 18 months.
Strategy & Operations sits inside Revenue Operations alongside GTM Systems, Revenue Enablement, and GTM Finance. You will also partner closely with Growth, Central Data, and Corporate Finance.
What You'll Do
Strategy and Planning

• Own segmentation, partner tiering, and book of business design across BD and Partner Success.

• Partner with GTM Finance on the capacity model, quotas, and headcount plan.

• Define the metrics and instrumentation for the business, including in-year GBV, partner-sourced pipeline, and Engine X attach.

• Build and run the partnerships operating cadence: annual planning, tier calibration, weekly and monthly pipeline reviews, and QBRs with strategic partners.

Partnerships Motion

• Standardize the motion: partner types, handoffs, stages, exit criteria, and rules of engagement.

• Partner with Revenue Enablement to translate strategy into training, playbooks, and tools the field will use.

• Partner with GTM Finance on comp design and visibility.

• Own partner economics with GTM Finance: rev-share models, contract structures, and deal desk.

AI, Systems, and Insights

• Set the AI strategy for the partnerships motion and lead the rollout across partner scoring, pipeline forecasting, deal desk, and rep-facing insights.

• Partner with GTM Systems on the tools, AI, and insights the field runs on.

• Test hypotheses on segmentation, coverage, and productivity, and translate them into decisions.

What You'll Bring

• 10+ years in strategy & operations or revenue operations, with substantial time inside a partnerships or channel organization at a high-growth B2B SaaS, fintech, or marketplace business.

• A track record as the primary strategic and operational partner to a VP or C-level revenue leader.

• A clear point of view on where AI and automation belong in a modern partnerships motion, and evidence of shipping it at scale.

Our team covers a broad range of trust and safety related topics including software engineering, data science, user engagement, privacy, threat detection, incident response, and bridging gaps between security and the broader Datadog business. You will bring expertise in a few of these areas.

 

You’ll join a growing security team at an ideal time for making a big impact. Datadog is growing rapidly, and AI-assisted development is increasing both the pace of software delivery and the amount of activity generated by AI agents. The product is seeing very high growth, with the platform becoming more interactive and new products and features developed regularly.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Have a direct impact on customers and their overall trust of our platform.

• Drive the technical roadmap in collaboration with your team, product management, and other engineering teams to align our work with company-wide security objectives.

• Mentor a team of 3+ software and security engineers, emphasizing engineering quality, resiliency, and delivery.

• Develop user-friendly UI components that enable users to strengthen the security of their account.

• Create metrics and measurements to better understand how users are interacting with our security-related features and controls.

• Have an opportunity to work across the stack, implementing both front-end and back-end code.

• Develop risk scoring algorithms to classify potentially risky behavior or activity on our platform.

• Work in a highly collaborative role, often engaging with engineering teams beyond security.

• Contribute to security operations efforts including threat detection and response.

• Participate in Datadog’s incident response efforts.

 

Who You Are: 

• Have 5+ years of software security engineering experience, especially on teams building platform and user security features.

• An excellent communicator and collaborator, able to work effectively through complex technical problems with a diverse group of stakeholders.

• Prior experience working with product and design teams to deliver front-end features.

• Fluent in one or more modern coding languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, etc.).

• Comfortable working in a fast paced, high growth environment.

• Knowledgeable of abuse techniques in modern SaaS applications.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth: 

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney- we are on a mission to transform finance- and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

AI is only as useful as the data it can safely reach. As Director, Data Architecture, you will own how our organization’s information, from databases to data warehouses to email, documents, Notion, Confluence, and Slack, becomes discoverable, trustworthy, and securely available to AI assistants, agents, and search tools.

This is a senior technical leadership role with enterprise-wide architectural accountability.  You will own the direction, make the platform and standards decisions, and partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, product, engineering, and business leaders to ensure AI retrieves the right information for the right people and processes. This role focuses on data enablement and does not involve model training or development. You will initially be a team of one, hands-on while setting the foundation, and will build and lead a team of data architects and engineers as the company scales.

Responsibilities:

Set the architecture and strategy

• Own the enterprise target-state data architecture for AI enablement, spanning our data stores, integration layers, and a unified access layer across structured and unstructured content

• Set reference architectures for retrieval-based AI: ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, and retrieval APIs

• Establish company-wide standards for connectors, data contracts, APIs, and MCP-style integrations that expose enterprise data to AI tools

• Own a 12-month delivery roadmap and a multi-year data and AI-readiness strategy aligned to business priorities and budget, and secure executive sponsorship for both

Connect structured and unstructured data

• Set the ingestion approach for structured sources (ERP, CRM, finance, HR, operational systems) using batch, change detection, and streaming patterns

• Set the ingestion approach for unstructured and semi-structured sources, including email, documents (PDF, documentation, spreadsheet, slides), wikis and knowledge bases (Notion, Confluence), collaboration tools (Slack, Google Drive), and ticketing systems (JIRA, Github)

• Define  how content is parsed, cleaned, deduplicated, enriched with metadata, and kept fresh through incremental sync, change detection, and deletion handling

• Create and oversee a semantic and metadata layer (taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs where useful) so content from different systems can be connected and searched coherently

Protect what matters

• Be accountable for permission-aware AI retrieval that respects source-system access controls and user entitlements

• Lead data governance in partnership with Security, Privacy and Legal , including cataloging, lineage, metadata, ownership, retention, and quality standards

• Define enterprise policies for sensitive content in AI contexts, such as PII, confidential material, redaction, consent, and legal hold

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Egocentric 3D Human Pose)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video.
Human demonstration data is the foundation of robot learning, and its quality depends on accurately reconstructing human motion. In this role, you will develop models and production pipelines that transform head-mounted and body-mounted camera streams-including wide-FOV, stereo, motion-blurred, and heavily self-occluded video-into metrically accurate, temporally consistent 3D pose representations for robot policy training and human-to-robot motion retargeting.
You will work across the entire perception stack, including camera calibration, data annotation, model training, evaluation, and large-scale deployment. This role is ideal for engineers with strong expertise in both computer vision and deep learning who enjoy solving challenging real-world perception problems.
Responsibilities

• Develop state-of-the-art 3D body and hand pose estimation models for egocentric video using monocular and stereo camera systems.

• Build models for 2D/3D keypoint estimation, SMPL/SMPL-X, MANO, and full-body motion reconstruction.

• Address challenging egocentric vision problems, including severe self-occlusion, motion blur, rolling shutter artifacts, truncated limbs, extreme viewpoints, and hand-object interaction.

• Design and maintain camera geometry and calibration pipelines, including fisheye and wide-FOV camera models, stereo calibration, triangulation, and coordinate frame alignment.

• Improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility using filtering, kinematic constraints, multi-view fusion, and multi-modal sensor integration.

• Build scalable annotation, evaluation, and quality assurance pipelines for large-scale human motion datasets.

• Optimize large-scale model training and high-throughput inference pipelines for production environments.

• Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to convert reconstructed human motion into high-quality robot training data.

• Contribute to system architecture, engineering best practices, and the long-term evolution of the perception platform.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems.

• Hands-on experience with 3D human pose estimation, hand pose estimation, or human motion tracking from video.

• Strong understanding of multi-view geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, coordinate transformations, and projection models.

• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

• Solid knowledge of modern deep learning techniques, model training, evaluation, and production ML workflows.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with egocentric perception systems, AR/VR headsets, smart glasses, or wearable capture rigs.

• Expertise with SMPL, SMPL-X, MANO, inverse kinematics, markerless motion capture, or hand-object pose estimation.

• Familiarity with egocentric vision datasets and benchmarks.

• Experience with modern video and 3D learning architectures, including Video Transformers, diffusion-based motion models, or 3D CNNs.

• Experience building multi-camera capture systems, synchronization, and calibration infrastructure.

• Experience with human-to-robot motion retargeting, teleoperation, imitation learning, or dexterous manipulation.

• Experience developing annotation tools, active learning pipelines, or large-scale data quality systems.

• Publications at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, or 3DV, open-source contributions, or demonstrated impact in applied AI systems.

What We Offer

title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body - living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays - and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). The successful candidate will personally troubleshoot, repair, inspect, and maintain electrical and mechanical systems throughout the facility. A strong Maintenance Technician or Maintenance Supervisor who is ready to assume full ownership of the maintenance function may be considered. This position works frequently with 480V electrical systems, DC voltage, water pumps, vacuum pumps, furnace elements, fans, hydraulics, and other industrial equipment. The Maintenance Manager will also maintain repair records, manage preventive maintenance activities, monitor MRO inventory, assist with quality and safety initiatives, and support corrective actions. The current maintenance workload is approximately 40% preventive maintenance and 60% emergency or corrective repair. A major objective of this position is to improve the established maintenance program and move the facility toward a more preventive and reliability-focused model.
Key Responsibilities Electrical Maintenance and Troubleshooting Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair electrical failures affecting production and facility equipment. Inspect electrical components, wiring, connections, motors, controls, switches, relays, contactors, heating elements, and related equipment. Use appropriate testing equipment to identify electrical faults. Replace defective electrical components according to applicable safety requirements. Identify recurring electrical failures and recommend permanent corrective actions. Report unsafe electrical conditions immediately. Coordinate specialized electrical work with qualified contractors when required. Maintain accurate documentation of electrical repairs and recurring problems. Electrical issues are currently the most common type of maintenance emergency within the facility. Mechanical Maintenance Troubleshoot and repair mechanical systems and production equipment. Maintain water pumps, vacuum pumps, furnace elements, fans, motors, hydraulic equipment, and related components. Inspect equipment for wear, vibration, leaks, overheating, unusual noise, and other signs of mechanical failure. Evaluate whether equipment should be repaired, rebuilt, or replaced. Reduce repeat failures through root-cause analysis and corrective action. Maintain orderly tools, parts, and maintenance work areas. Vacuum Furnace Maintenance Perform routine and corrective maintenance on vacuum furnaces and related systems. Support the maintenance of vacuum pumps, heating elements, fans, controls, and supporting equipment. Investigate vacuum leaks, heating issues, electrical faults, and equipment-performance concerns. Coordinate furnace downtime and repairs with Operations and Production. Learn facility-specific furnace systems through company-provided on-site training. Maintain accurate records of furnace inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance activities. Previous vacuum furnace experience is a strong advantage but is not required. The company will provide on-site training to a candidate with strong transferable electrical and mechanical skills. Preventive and Predictive Maintenance Maintain and improve the established preventive maintenance program. Schedule preventive maintenance according to equipment condition, manufacturer recommendations, usage, production priorities, and operational risk. Coordinate maintenance activities with Operations and Quality. Complete inspections, lubrication, adjustments
